text:
Izzy Park: hi folks! izzy here, starting today as an ML engineer on Redwood Optimize. remote-first week. quick Qs: laptop status shows 'label printed', anyone seen delays? who do I ping for KMS/HSM access for private model tests? also tiny fun fact: i'm into urban beekeeping and made lavender honey last summer. :honey_pot: :bee:

Lena Ortiz: welcome izzy!! i'm your onboarding buddy, i'll set up a 30m walkthrough tomorrow. for KMS/HSM ping @Ravi Patel and cc eng-infra-bot. FYI our team meetup is Mon 10am PT. :tada:

Ravi Patel: @Izzy Park added. filing request for KMS access now (ticket INF-7892). laptop ETA's been a bit spotty this month but usually 2-3 business days after label printed. if you need a temp VM reply and IT will spin one up.

it-helpdesk: Ticket INF-7892 created for Izzy Park: Temporary cloud dev VM provisioned (ubuntu-22.04). SSH: izzy@temp-dev-611.redwood.internal. Key placed in 1Password -> "IT Temp Keys". Laptop status updated to "shipped".

Izzy Park: awesome thanks IT. i'll try SSH later. anyone have preferred editor settings or dotfiles starter? i prefer minimal config.

Amaya Chen: we have a dotfiles-starter repo with editorconfig + eslint + recommended theme. i'll invite you to it and drop the link in a DM. also accept the GitHub org invite, eng-infra-bot will post when done.

eng-infra-bot: Added Izzy Park to org "redwood-inference" and teams: optimize-ml, optimize-evals. Please accept the invite sent to your email.

Izzy Park: invite received and accepted. SSH to temp VM successful. thanks all!

Lena Ortiz: quick heads-up: we'll do a "show and tell" on Fri at 4pm PT for new hires, bring a small non-work thing. honey jars absolutely count :grin:

Nora (People Ops): welcome izzy! sent the swag form and a calendar invite for the weekly new-hire coffee tomorrow at 11am PT. also we can ship a small plant or a starter bee-friendly herb kit if you want it included in your welcome package.

Izzy Park: love that — i'll sign up for the herb kit (lavender would be perfect). i'll share a pic of the beehive and a tiny honey jar at Friday's show-and-tell. excited to be here :rocket:
